verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official, npm-published Editor MCP server that lets AI agents connect to and modify an open Editor session (scene/entity/property edits, viewport verification), plus a separate documented Editor API (api.playcanvas.com/editor) for programmatic scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tooling. This directly covers agent-driven scene/node creation, property editing, and automation through a documented scriptable interface. missing for 10: explicit documented support for triggering builds/publishes via MCP or API, and independent hands-on verification of the MCP server beyond first-party docs/version metadata.
